english.note: Use this colloquial word when focusing on someone’s ability to come up with clever ideas or approaches.

examples.english: Your ingenuity is amazing—you can even turn a broken fan into an extractor.
examples.traditional: 你真係多諗頭，連壞咗嘅風扇都可以整成抽氣機。
